mentions.name: pginbox
mentions.description: Web interface for browsing and searching the PostgreSQL mailing lists. It polls a Fastmail inbox to ingest new messages nearly instantly; anyone can browse without an account, while registered users can follow threads to be notified of new messages, with threads containing their registered email auto-followed, plus quality-of-life settings. Search currently does keyword matching on subjects, with improved search planned next.

mentions.name: pginbox
mentions.description: A web app that downloads and parses the pgsql-hackers mailing list and presents it as an alternative thread display, with plans to explore hybrid search and improve on the official mailing list site's basic search features.
mentions.problem: The official mailing list site has a clean thread display but its search features are basic.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Very much mvp but I just got this all set up: https://www.pginbox.dev/

Downloaded and parsed a bunch of the pgsql-hackers mailing list. Right now it’s just a pretty basic alternative display, but I have some ideas I want to explore around hybrid search and a few other things. The official site for the mailing list has a pretty clean thread display but the search features are basic so I’m trying to see how I can improve on that.
